platformFacts.typingMindImportPath: Settings -> Manage Models -> Add Custom Model -> Import OpenRouter -> enter key -> Check API Key -> select models -> Import Models
platformFacts.perKeyBudgetControl: OpenRouter supports per-key limit plus daily/weekly/monthly limit_reset; no organization required for per-key limit.
platformFacts.privacy: OpenRouter supports ZDR and data_collection=deny routing controls. Account-level ZDR disables OpenRouter response caching; per-request ZDR does not itself disable response-cache eligibility.
platformFacts.flex: OpenRouter service_tier=flex can reduce price for supported OpenAI/Google routes while preserving requested model identity; actual served tier must be recorded.
platformFacts.cache: Explicit session_id enables sticky provider routing and can improve prompt-cache locality.
